summary: Built NPDev Manager 0.5.1 from source (Build/manager-target/quick/npdev-manager; starts only outside VS Code's snap terminal or with env -i) and walked the owner through the IMP-GAPS-1 and AIP-4 4.5 steps. A read-only scout audited /api/admin and /api/runtime auth: there is no central role gate; tenant ADMIN can rewrite the shared model (SemanticBehaviorWriteBackController.apply, RealPublicationExecutor and about six publication/rollback controllers), and /api/admin/storage/summary has no role check. Nothing fixed yet. Earlier in the session: LIBS-FRESH, REG-300 and ENF-1 54 -> 49 landed (see the previous handoff).
nextStep: Waiting on the owner for two answers. (1) Should the scout's security fixes go ahead, and is SUPERUSER (not tenant ADMIN) the gate for changing the shared model? (2) Once answered, in order: (a) ENF-1: add orchestrationAction.map to probe 91's keywords, remove it from the allowlist in scripts/policy/dsl-behavior-witness.json and lower frozenCount 49 -> 48, then run check-dsl-behavior-witness.py. (b) Require SUPERUSER on POST /api/admin/model/semantic-behavior-writeback/apply (NPDevRuntimeHost/src/main/java/com/finalexec/api/SemanticBehaviorWriteBackController.java:73-80) and on the RealPublicationExecutor / PublicationExecutor / PublicationRollbackExecutor / RollbackExecution / SourceMutationApprovalGate / Semantic- and StructuralPublicationMapping POSTs, following MetadataHotSwapController /apply (~:423). Make their /history reads SUPERUSER-only or tenant-filtered. Add a role check to StorageSummaryController (runtimehost-core/.../api/StorageSummaryController.java:35). Write a unit test per controller, proven red on the old code. (c) X0: selectDueScheduledEvents catch (GeneratedCrudRuntimeSupport.java ~1685) and claimScheduledEvent must not read a failure as no_due_records or skipped. (d) Open a ledger item for query.permissionRequirements, query.tracePolicy, aggregateCollection.via and flowStep.data: compiled but never read at runtime. When the owner sends AIP-4 screenshots (evidence/aip-4-manager-real-2026-10-23/) or the WmsOffice files (OutsideRepo/wmsoffice-sources/), act on those first.
blocked: AIP-4 4.5: the owner must run the Manager with a real key (free Gemini) or Ollama and take screenshots. IMP-GAPS-1: needs WmsLabs_CreateTables.html, the GeneXus tables export and WmsLabs_Mod_GX17.xml from the owner. OWN-2: owner outreach. The admin-endpoint fixes wait on the owner's answer about the SUPERUSER gate.
verified: Manager quick build succeeded (11m53s, 1 warning). A 10s smoke launch with a clean env stayed up with no errors; launched from the VS Code snap env it crashed (GLib schema error, then a libpthread symbol error).
